title: Sub-Domain URL Segmentation
description: Given a string representing a raw domain sequence, partition the string such that every substring of the partition is a symmetric palindrome. Return all possible palindrome partitioning configurations of the string.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters.
output_format: A list of string lists containing all valid palindrome partitions.

examples.explanation: Both [a, a, b] and [aa, b] consist entirely of palindromic substrings.
A single character string is inherently a palindrome.
Valid partitions include individual characters and the full string.
